Problem Statement:
An e-commerce platform wants to validate promotional codes. A valid promotional code must: Be exactly 10 characters long. Contain at least one digit and one uppercase letter. Write a program to check whether the promotional code is valid. 
Write a C program to validate a promotional code based on the given criteria. 
Sample Input:
ABCD1234EF 
Sample Output:
Valid promotional code.
